messages:
anya-partnerships: Heads up — we need to revote on MDF priority buckets ahead of Friday's QBR. I pushed a one-pager to the drive (link in thread). Main ask: do we promote HW co-fund to High priority or keep current split? @sara-finance @mike-sales please weigh in.

mike-sales: Saw the deck. Strong +1 for promoting HW co-fund. Pipeline from marketplace OEMs looks real and SI integrations will convert faster with hardware credits. Recommend shifting 15% from general marketing MDF into HW co-fund.

danielle-ops: Ops note — if we increase HW co-fund we should ringfence 30% of that for enablement (install + enablement workshops) so deals don't stall. Otherwise we'll see dropoff.

josh-engineering: Heads up from eng: SI integrations require ~2 sprints of partner integration work for each OEM pilot. If we bump HW funding, we need to commit 2 FTEs for 6 weeks to support onboarding. Might need to coordinate with infra schedule.

sara-finance: Short on headroom this quarter. If we reallocate to HW, we need concrete offsets. Could do -20% to trade shows and reclassify $50k as co-marketing credits (not MDF), but need approval from revenue ops.

eve-legal: No legal blockers for adjusting MDF buckets. One ask: update co-funding terms in SOW templates to reflect HW credits (clarify refundable vs milestone-based credits). I'll draft language.

anya-partnerships: Thanks. Two quick asks: 1) react with :thumbsup: if you approve the HW-up revision (we'll treat no reaction as abstain) 2) flag any redlines by EOD, I need to present consolidated recommendation at the QBR prep sync tomorrow.

partners-bot: Poll created by anya-partnerships — "MDF priority revote" (options: current_split, hw_up, reserve_enablement). Voting open for 24 hours. Results will post in thread.

mike-sales: voted hw_up :thumbsup:

danielle-ops: voted reserve_enablement — want the 30% ringfence for enablement preserved.

sara-finance: tentative vote current_split until we see the exact offsets. I'll work with revops to model the numbers by 4pm.

josh-engineering: noted, will confirm capacity and flag if we need to deprioritize any infra work.

eve-legal: I'll drop a draft SOW clause into the drive folder now.

anya-partnerships: Cool — I'll compile votes and the proposed deltas and post an updated one-pager by 3pm. Action items: @sara-finance run offset scenarios, @josh-engineering confirm capacity, @eve-legal upload clause, @danielle-ops confirm enablement budget mechanics. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
